'''Tokks'vik''' was a clan-[[City/Legends|city]] on [[Doneer'so]]. It was the major [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and was supportive of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="CP" />
